source_catalog.title: 12대 PC 도입 공개 검토 상세 보고서 정정판
접근 허용 중인 내부 연락 부록

input.user_utterance: 정정 공개 보고서의 가격과 납기로 구매 검토 메일 초안 작성해줘. 정정 단가와 납기, 예산 조건을 포함하고 실제 발송과 비공개 연락처 사용을 하지 않은 초안로 부탁해. 기존에 채택한 조건과 제외 범위를 지키고, 초안만 만들어줘. 실제 외부 실행은 하지 마.

payload.instruction: Interpret this actual CURRENT user utterance against prior adopted public state and available source catalog. Decide whether the user requests a new downstream draft or explicitly closes without delegation. Return JSON {action:'DELEGATE'|'CLOSE',purpose:string,completion_condition:string,recipient:string|null,targets:[source ID strings],handling:string,artifact_type:string}. Resolve requested purpose, bounded output form/completion, actual source targets and an appropriate recipient from available adapters. The handling is a concrete future intention suitable for a first UI response, not an empty acknowledgement or an unsupported completion claim. Preserve stated restrictions (draft only, no sending, exclusions); prior constraints remain authoritative. Metadata is not source facts; do not invent evidence contents. CLOSE means no new agent work. Do not perform domain planning.

source_response.purpose: Draft a purchase review email based on the corrected public report, focusing on price and delivery schedule while adhering to budget constraints and exclusions.
source_response.completion_condition: A text draft of the email is generated, incorporating price grounds and delivery/introduction schedule from the source, respecting the 14,000,000 KRW budget ceiling, quantity of 12, tax-included status, and excluding installation convenience, unverified total operating cost, and private contact details. No external sending or real actions are performed.
source_response.handling: Generate a bounded text draft for the user to review, extracting relevant data from lines 17-32 (Price Grounds) and 33-48 (Delivery and Introduction Schedule) of the 'large-public-report', ensuring no private contact details from the revoked 'private-annex' are included.
